items.title: Lisa Parrott interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 22, 2021
items.q: Oh my God yes. Yeah, mainly through Miles, but I mean how can you touch like his rhythmic feel is just to die for.

ctx.x: Oh my God yes. Yeah, mainly through Miles, but I mean how can you touch like his rhythmic feel is just to die for. It’s just — I love how free he is on the saxophone, it’s just amazing, his time feel.

Well every musician, I suspect especially in New York, has to wear a lot of musical hats to survive I would think. I think you’re the first person I’ve spoken with in this manner that did significant copying, was a copyist.
